# hostd_vm_firewall_options (Resource)

Whether a VM firewall is enabled, and its default inbound and outbound policies. The firewall filters the public interface. Destroy removes this resource from state only; the VM keeps the settings. Import with `<project_id>,<vmid>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_vm_firewall_options" "web" {
  project_id = hostd_vm.web.project_id
  vmid       = hostd_vm.web.vmid
  enable     = true
  policy_in  = "DROP"
  policy_out = "ACCEPT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the VM firewall is enabled.
- `policy_in` (String) Default policy for inbound traffic: `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.
- `policy_out` (String) Default policy for outbound traffic: `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the VM belongs to.
- `vmid` (Number) VM identifier (`hostd_vm.vmid`).
